```mcstas
DEFINE INSTRUMENT SANS_Pinhole()

TRACE

COMPONENT Origin = Progress_bar()
AT (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Source = Source_simple(
    radius = 0.02,
    dist = 3.0,
    focus_r = 0.005,
    lambda0 = 6.0,
    dlambda = 0.05,
    flux = 1e8)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Pinhole1 = Aperture(
    radius = 0.005)
AT (0, 0, 3.0) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Pinhole2 = Aperture(
    radius = 0.005)
AT (0, 0, 6.0) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Sample = Sans_spheres(
    r = 100,
    phi = 0.001,
    drho = 0.6,
    sigma_abs = 0.5,
    xwidth = 0.01,
    yheight = 0.01,
    zdepth = 0.005)
AT (0, 0, 6.2) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Beamstop1 = Beamstop(
    r = 0.02)
AT (0, 0, 9.1) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT Detector = PSD_monitor(
    nx = 128,
    ny = 128,
    xwidth = 0.6,
    yheight = 0.6,
    filename = "psd_detector.dat")
AT (0, 0, 9.2) RELATIVE Origin

COMPONENT L_mon = L_monitor(
    nchan = 100,
    xwidth = 0.6,
    yheight = 0.6,
    Lmin = 5.5,
    Lmax = 6.5,
    filename = "l_monitor.dat",
    restore_neutron = 1)
AT (0, 0, 9.201) RELATIVE Origin

END
```
